info.title: api2skill
info.description: Converts an OpenAPI/Swagger document into a self-contained Claude Agent Skill (SKILL.md + a runnable .cs/.fsx/.csx/.py dispatcher + reference docs + a secrets scaffold) so an existing REST API becomes something Claude can call correctly, with authentication.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate a Claude Skill from an OpenAPI/Swagger document

options.name: --spec
options.description: OpenAPI source (repeatable). When present, positional spec-source is optional.

options.name: --spec-id
options.description: Id for the corresponding --spec (same order). Defaults to slug of source.

options.name: --spec-label
options.description: Display label for the corresponding --spec (same order). Defaults to id.

options.name: --on-conflict
options.description: operationId collision across parts: fail (default) or prefix. [default: fail]

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory. Defaults to ./<slug-of-title>.

options.name: --name
options.description: Override the skill name (defaults to a slug of info.title).

options.name: --script
options.description: Emitter to use: cs, fsx, csx, py. Default: cs. [default: cs]

options.name: --include
options.description: Keep only matching tag:/path:/op: selectors (repeatable).

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Drop matching tag:/path:/op: selectors (repeatable, applied after --include).

options.name: --force
options.description: Regenerate over an existing output directory.

options.name: --insecure
options.description: Dev-only: accept untrusted HTTPS certificates when fetching a spec URL or making generated calls.

options.name: --format
options.description: Force the input format (json|yaml) instead of sniffing it.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL to use when the spec has no `servers` entry.

options.name: --auth-config
options.description: Path to an auth.json (explicit auth profiles) — contracts/auth-config.md. Mutually exclusive with --auth.

options.name: --auth
options.description: Shorthand: scaffold a single global auth profile of type bearer|basic|custom. oauth2/entra need --auth-config. Mutually exclusive with --auth-config.

options.name: --login
options.description: After writing the skill, run interactive login for each authorization_code auth profile.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: SPEC_SOURCE
arguments.description: Local file path, remote URL, or '-' for stdin. Optional when --spec is used.

commands.description: Interactive OAuth login for a generated skill (--skill)

options.name: --skill
options.description: Skill root directory (contains auth.json).

options.name: --mode
options.description: Capture mode: auto|http|https|scheme|hosted (default auto). [default: auto]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the redirect (default 180). [default: 180]

options.name: --cert
options.description: PFX/PKCS#12 path for HTTPS loopback.

options.name: --cert-password
options.description: PFX password (prompted on TTY if needed).

options.name: --cert-pem
options.description: PEM certificate path (with --cert-key) for HTTPS loopback.

options.name: --cert-key
options.description: PEM private key path (with --cert-pem) for HTTPS loopback.

options.name: --relay-base
options.description: Hosted relay base URL (overrides API2SKILL_OAUTH_RELAY_BASE).

commands.name: update
commands.description: Regenerate a previously generated skill from a newer OpenAPI/Swagger document, reusing its saved generation options.

options.name: --name
options.description: Rename the skill (same semantics as 'generate --name'). Defaults to the name recorded in .api2skill.json.

options.name: --out
options.description: Relocate the skill to a new output directory (same semantics as 'generate --out'). Defaults to <skill-path> (update in place).

options.name: --spec-id
options.description: When the skill has multiple spec parts, required with a positional spec-source to select which part to replace (D10).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: SKILL_PATH
arguments.description: Path to a previously generated skill directory (must contain .api2skill.json).

arguments.name: SPEC_SOURCE
arguments.description: New spec source (file, URL, or '-'). Defaults to the source recorded at generation time.
